identitySignals: Name matches 'Illuminaries', a Bay Area street art and mural agency (illuminaries.art) that describes itself as doing murals for schools and cities
Press coverage (Mission Local) describes Illuminaries murals in Oakland, matching the Oakland, CA location in the agenda

A mural/design firm is plausible for a decorative element on the Fremont new construction project, but no page found links Illuminaries to OUSD or Fremont High School, and no headquarters city or registry record was found
research.notes: Could not confirm this is the same entity OUSD contracted: no source links Illuminaries to OUSD or the Fremont project, no CA Secretary of State record was retrieved, and the site gives no address or phone. Site footer reportedly shows ILLUMINARIES, LLC but that was not verified, so legalName is omitted. Reviewer should check the Legistar attachment for the vendor's address/contact.

profile.summary: Illuminaries is a Bay Area street art agency that paints custom murals for brands, cities, offices, schools, events and homes. It also offers workshops and graphic design services.
